# JobPipe

> JobPipe is a free, no-signup, local-first job and freelance application tracker. It runs entirely in the browser: a Kanban board, proposal templates, follow-up reminders, and statistics, with all data stored only in the user's browser (IndexedDB). No accounts, no server, no analytics.

## Docs

- [JobPipe home](https://jobpipe.vercel.app/): Landing page, features, how it works, privacy summary, and FAQ.
- [Privacy](https://jobpipe.vercel.app/privacy): What JobPipe stores, what it does not collect, and how export and import work.
- [About](https://jobpipe.vercel.app/about): Why JobPipe exists, how it works, and what it deliberately does not do.
- [Changelog](https://jobpipe.vercel.app/changelog): Version history and roadmap items not yet released.

## Features

- [Open the app](https://jobpipe.vercel.app/app): Kanban board with Saved, Applied, Interview, Offer, and Rejected stages.
- [Open the app](https://jobpipe.vercel.app/app): Proposal templates with {company}, {role}, {name}, and {skills} placeholders.
- [Open the app](https://jobpipe.vercel.app/app): Follow-up reminders for overdue and due-today applications.
- [Open the app](https://jobpipe.vercel.app/app): Statistics: applications per week, response rate, and interview rate.
- [Open the app](https://jobpipe.vercel.app/app): JSON export and import with validation and overwrite confirmation.

## Privacy

- [Privacy](https://jobpipe.vercel.app/privacy): Data lives only in the user's browser; there is no server and no tracking.
